scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @travel-movie/schema build && pnpm --filter @travel-movie/core build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @travel-movie/server dev" "pnpm --filter @travel-movie/web dev"
scripts.render:demo: pnpm --filter @travel-movie/schema build && pnpm --filter @travel-movie/server build && pnpm --filter @travel-movie/server render:demo
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @travel-movie/schema build && pnpm --filter @travel-movie/core build && pnpm -r --if-present test
